svg.text: an odd node or session name:
each value quoted, the exact session
a person can attach at any time
Ctrl-C typed there reaches the engine
no answer in 10 s, or no pane printed: the
session ran on, unwatched. Now kill-session
never after a non-zero exit: that session
may be another launch's, still live
